text:
carmen: Heads-up — I'm proposing a temporary pin for runtime 3.2.1 in eu-west for llm-quant models. SDK 2.8.0 + runtime 3.3 produced decoding mismatches on long-seq (>2048) on quant-v3b canary. Small fix in flight but we need to limit blast radius. Looking for +1s and a deploybot pin command.
ben: What kind of mismatch? correctness, or just formatting/noise?
carmen: Correctness — tokens getting garbled in ~0.4% of requests on canary. Not timing-related, appears kernel/quant decode path edge case.
dmitri: Can we do region-scoped pin only? avoid global pin. Suggest add reroute to v3a variant as a fallback policy while we patch 3.3.
alice: I'll run the smoke eval set (long-seq + regen test) against pinned vs canary and post diffs.
eva: +1 for eu-west only. Add QA gate (60m) before we decide full unpin. Also add telemetry alert thresholds.

carmen: Proposed deploybot command below. ETA on runtime patch ~tomorrow morning (small kernel shim). If QA shows regressions we escalate to rollforward with 3.3.1 patch.

```bash
# apply regional pin for llm-quant-v3b
/deploybot pin add --model llm-quant-v3b \
  --runtime 3.2.1 \
  --regions eu-west \
  --reason "decode mismatch with SDK 2.8.0 on runtime 3.3 canary" \
  --expires 2027-07-15T10:30:00Z
```

deploybot: executing pin... applying to 38 nodes in eu-west. current status: in-progress -> applied.

deploybot: Pin applied: model=llm-quant-v3b runtime=3.2.1 regions=[eu-west] nodes=38 expires=2027-07-15T10:30:00Z

ben: ok good. Do we need a rollback plan for SDK 2.8.0? Should we revert SDK in-app clients?
carmen: Not yet — the issue seems on the runtime kernel with quant decode. SDK revert would be heavier; prefer runtime patch 3.3.1. We'll monitor and decide within the QA window.
dmitri: Can we set an automated fallback policy: if failed_decodes > 50/min in eu-west for 10m, route requests for model llm-quant-v3b -> llm-quant-v3a (lossy but stable)?
alice: I can wire the eval/telemetry to the same alert and run a quick AB test to measure user-visible regression if routed to v3a.
eva: Please also update release-notes /ops channel: short blurb so SRE/support know to expect temporary pin and fallback routing.

carmen: Plan summary:
- Action: Pin runtime 3.2.1 for llm-quant-v3b in eu-west (applied).
- Gate: QA smoke + eval for 60m (alice running) — if pass, keep pin until 6h then re-evaluate for targeted unpin.
- Fallback: Automated reroute to v3a on failed_decodes threshold (dmitri to configure).
- Follow-up: runtime 3.3.1 patch tomorrow; if patch fixes issues, plan staged unpin and remove reroute. If not, consider SDK rollback (last-resort).

carmen: tagging @dmitri @alice @eva for visibility. :white_check_mark:

ben: :thumbsup:
dmitri: configuring reroute + alert now, will post policy id.
alice: smoke eval started — posting diffs in 10m.
eva: I'll add the short note to #ops and update release-notes draft.

deploybot: note: to remove pin later use:
```
/deploybot pin remove --model llm-quant-v3b --regions eu-west --reason "post-patch unpin" 
```

carmen: Thanks everyone — will reconvene if telemetry trips or QA finds anything concerning.
